# Joshua and Jericho (Joshua 6:8)

## Emotional Focus
Obeying God’s way even when it doesn’t make sense.

## Key KJV
“And the people did as Joshua commanded.” (Joshua 6:8)

## Gentle Retelling
God told Joshua to march around Jericho’s walls for seven days. They obeyed and shouted on the seventh day. The walls fell flat just like God promised.

## Coloring Prompt
Joshua and the people marching around tall city walls with trumpets.

## Read-Along Flow + Response
“God’s way always works when we obey.”
